action.query:
SELECT ORDER_DATE, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN IS_CANCELLED THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 6) AS CANCELLATION_RATE_PCT
FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY ORDER_DATE
ORDER BY ORDER_DATE
LIMIT 40;
action.reason: MetricFlow result exceeded 40 rows. Using SQL to return cancellation rate as a percentage by recorded order date, limited to 40 days as required.

action.answer: The cancellation rate, as a percentage, during 2025 by recorded order date ranged from approximately 5.614554% to 6.449646% for the first 40 days of the year. For example, on 2025-01-01 the cancellation rate was 6.449646%, and on 2025-01-10 it was 5.614554%. Each value represents the percentage of orders cancelled out of all orders placed on that specific date. The population is all orders recorded on each day in 2025 (up to the first 40 days shown). Unit: percent (%). Interpretation: On each day, about 5.6% to 6.4% of orders were cancelled, with minor daily variation.
